name: insert_sorted_entry_from_node
description: Walks the sorted entry list from a given node, inserting an entry with the supplied key, value and flags and linking it into the list when the key is not already present.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:25A22
name: insert_sorted_entry_at_head
description: Allocates a twelve-byte entry from the list pool, fills in its key, value and flags, links it into the sorted list and walks the list to restore its order.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:25A46
name: link_list_node_with_values
description: Links a list node into place by moving pointers, writes a key word and data words into the node, and sets a flag byte when the zero condition holds.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:25A7C
name: insert_sorted_node_from_index
description: Walks the sorted list from an index, following links until the key position is found, then links in a new node with the given key and updates its flag byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:25ABE
name: write_node_data_conditional
description: Writes a key word and three data words into a list node, first updating the node index when the zero condition is set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:25AD2
name: update_list_with_flag
description: Advances the list pool pointer and links a new node when the zero condition is clear, then writes data words and a flag byte into the node.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:25B06
name: find_or_insert_list_key
description: Walks the sorted list to the position for a 16-bit key, and when the key is not already present allocates a node from the pool, links it in and writes its data words.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:25B58
name: traverse_list_check_flag
description: Follows next links from a node until a key threshold is met with a flag bit set, then writes a flag byte and a fixed link value into the node.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:25B7C
name: mark_list_nodes_in_range
description: Walks the sorted node list and writes a fixed flag value into nodes whose flag bit is set and whose keys fall within a range, inserting a node where needed.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:25B9A
name: update_sorted_list_node_values
description: Walks the sorted node list to the position for a key, then updates the data words of an existing node or inserts a new node when the key is absent.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:25BEC
name: insert_list_node_with_flag
description: Inserts a node with a key and three data words when the key differs from the current node, and writes a flag word and flag byte into the node.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:25C14
name: reset_list_node_flags
description: Optionally allocates and initialises a node, then walks the list setting a flag word to a fixed value in each node whose flag bit is set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:25C54
name: transform_frame_vector_with_matrix
description: Multiplies three frame values by a 3x3 matrix read through a pointer in the frame and stores the nine products as results in the frame.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:25CFA
name: transform_shifted_triplet_from_pointer
description: Shifts three register-passed values right by a count taken from their magnitude, multiplies them by a 3x3 matrix read through a frame pointer, and stores the shifted products as results in the frame.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:25D78
name: store_shifted_register_values
description: Stores three register values shifted right by a count, and three sign-extended words, into six consecutive slots of the frame.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:25D9E
name: transform_frame_vector_pointer
description: Multiplies three frame values by a 3x3 matrix read through a frame pointer and stores the nine products as results in the frame.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:25E50
name: transform_triplet_frame_matrix
description: Shifts three register-passed values right by a count taken from their magnitude, multiplies them by a 3x3 matrix read through a frame pointer, and stores the scaled results.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:25EDA
name: store_shifted_register_values_alt
description: Stores six register values into consecutive frame slots, shifting the first three by a variable count and sign-extending the last three.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:25F00
name: compute_absolute_position_sum
description: Reads six 32-bit fields from a record at fixed offsets, takes absolute values of the pairs with carry handling, and combines them into a 64-bit sum returned to the caller.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:25F5A
name: transform_pair_with_shift_return
description: Shifts three register-passed values right by a count derived from their magnitude, multiplies two rows of a 3x3 matrix in memory by them, and returns the two shifted results as a 64-bit value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:25FD6
name: return_shifted_pair
description: Returns two register values, each shifted right by a count taken from another register, packed together as a 64-bit value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:25FF6
name: subtract_and_shift_difference
description: Computes a 64-bit difference between two stored values, shifts it right in a loop by a count from a register, and stores the result with a status byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26074
name: setup_frame_state_from_args
description: Stores register and address arguments into frame slots, selects a matrix pointer from a table by a byte in the record, and computes position sums for the transforms that follow.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26114
name: store_transform_inputs_in_frame
description: Stores six words and nine 32-bit values from its arguments into frame slots, sets a status byte to 255, reads flag bytes from the records and calls helper routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26178
name: process_pending_frame_entries
description: Decrements a frame counter in a loop, calling a helper on each pass, and when a pending flag is set performs a follow-up update before finishing.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26188
name: apply_pending_frame_update
description: When a pending flag is set and a status byte allows it, computes a scaled vector from matrix coefficients in the record and stores it in the frame.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2618C
name: run_pending_pair_updates
description: Loops over a counter, calling helpers that process pairs of records, and when the status byte has its top bit set and the optional flags allow it, updates a frame value until the counter expires.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:261D0
name: combine_pair_positions_and_flags
description: Compares the type and direction bytes of two records, setting a status byte for matching pairs, and otherwise calls a helper with sums of record positions and frame offsets while looping over candidate entries.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26242
name: finish_pending_pair_loop
description: Clears a status byte and runs the pending pair loop, calling helpers until the counter expires and applying a follow-up update when the status flag is set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26266
name: set_pending_flag_then_loop
description: Sets a status byte from a record direction flag, then runs the pending pair loop until its counter expires.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2627E
name: clear_pending_flag_then_loop
description: Clears a status byte and runs the pending pair loop until its counter expires.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26290
name: apply_relative_position_pair
description: Scans candidate records and, for those with matching type bytes, calls a helper with the difference between frame positions and record positions or with zeros when the direction flags match, looping until all candidates are processed.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2631A
name: clear_status_run_pair_loop
description: Clears a status byte and runs the pending pair loop, calling helpers for each candidate until the counter expires, with a follow-up step when the status allows it.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2633E
name: emit_zero_pair_run_loop
description: Calls a helper with zero values when the record's direction flag is set, clears the status byte and runs the pending pair loop until its counter expires.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26384
name: clear_status_and_loop_variant
description: Clears a status byte and runs the pending pair loop, calling helpers for each candidate until the counter expires.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:263AC
name: emit_negated_pair_clear_status
description: When a type byte matches, clears the status byte, otherwise calls a helper with negated record positions and offsets for matching direction flags, then continues the candidate loop.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26420
name: run_pair_loop_tail
description: Clears a status byte and continues the pending pair loop, calling helpers for remaining candidates until the counter expires and applying a follow-up update when the status flag is set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26448
name: clear_status_enter_pair_loop
description: Clears a status byte and enters the pending pair loop, calling helpers for each candidate until the counter expires.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2647A
name: apply_pending_pair_update
description: When the status byte bit and the flags allow it, combines pair records with matrix coefficients and frame values, calls helpers and stores the results in the frame.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:264B8
name: store_frame_vector_and_transform
description: Stores a helper result and two values into frame slots, then, when a flag bit is set, multiplies them by a matrix read through a frame pointer.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:264C4
name: construct_return_from_globals
description: Reads two global 32-bit values, calls a helper, and returns a 64-bit value built from the helper's two results and the two global values each halved.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26546
name: transform_pending_pair_frame
description: Reads frame values for the pending pair and, when flag bits allow, computes fixed-point sums of matrix products and a scaled value, storing the results in the frame.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:265F6
name: transform_3d_coordinates
description: Multiplies three register-passed coordinates by a 3x3 matrix held in a record, computes fixed-point scaled sums, and stores the transformed position and velocity values in the frame under flag control.
